nodes.title: Connector test panel dispatch state
nodes.summary: The test dispatch outcome in useTestConnectorPanel modeled as a discriminated union instead of three independent fields, fixing a TYP-04 finding.

nodes.title: Model the test dispatch outcome as a discriminated union
nodes.summary: TestConnectorPanelState's isTesting/result/testError fields are replaced by one discriminated testOutcome field, so a stale result and a live error can never coexist in the type a caller reads.
